page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head "IURIS." with page number "579" at the top. Below the head, the column continues from the previous page, followed by a decorative rule, the division title, headings, and paragraphs. Gathering signature at the bottom right.

main_text.l: videatur, sed propter aliquam causam Actori iniquè
noceat: rursus alia allegatione opus est, quà actor
Erant interdicta formæ atq; conceptiones verbo-
rum quibus prætor aut jubebat aliquid fieri,
aut fieri prohibebat: quod tunc maximè fiebat, cùm
de possessione, aut quasi possessione inter aliquos
Summa divisio interdictorum hæc est: quòd aut
prohibitoria sunt, aut restitutoria, aut exhibitoria.
Secunda divisio interdictorum hæc est, quòd quæ-
dam adipiscendæ possessionis causa comparata sunt;
Tertia divisio interdictorum hæc est, quòd aut sim-
plicia sunt, aut duplicia. Simplicia sunt, veluti in
quibus alter Actor, alter Reus est: Qualia sunt omnia

page.notes: The initial "E" of "Erant" is a decorative capital, joined to the word. The gathering mark at the foot is an ornament followed by "2"; the ornament is uncertain, so the signature is marked [?]. The title line "Von richterlichen verbotten und verbotten." is black letter and is set in <bl>. The parenthetical German glosses are black letter inside roman text. The printed "§.fumma" is read as "§. summa" under the long-s rule. The first line of the column is a continuation from the previous page. No other damage or doubtful readings.
